name: VibeSys agent layer
description: Node, the four provider CLIs, a non-root `agent` user (uid 1000), and VibeSys's uv-managed Python with the MCP library. Debian/Ubuntu bases only.

node_version.description: Node.js version from nodejs.org; default mirrors vs_agent.provider_policy.NODE_VERSION.

python_version.description: Python version uv installs for VibeSys's own processes; default mirrors vs_agent.provider_policy.
